How we deliver如何落地03

From a first image to a working environment.从第一张概念图，到可运行的真实空间。

01
Spatial Media Content空间媒体内容
大尺寸数字内容、异形屏、环幕、穹幕、裸眼 3D、演出 Opening 与常设空间影像。 Large-format digital content, custom LED canvases, panoramic and dome environments, glasses-free 3D, show openings and permanent media installations.
02
Immersive Environments沉浸式环境
沉浸式空间、Projection Mapping、水幕、雾幕、雾森与建筑媒体体验。 Immersive environments, projection mapping, water and mist screens, fog forests and architectural media.
03
Interactive Installations互动装置
动作、声音、触摸、视觉识别、传感器与多人参与式体验。 Motion, sound, touch, computer vision, sensors and participatory multi-user experiences.
04
Realtime + Show Control实时系统与播控
Unreal、Unity、TouchDesigner、多屏同步、OSC、MIDI、LTC、DMX 与现场播控。 Unreal, Unity, TouchDesigner, multi-screen synchronisation, OSC, MIDI, LTC, DMX and live show control.
05
Spatial Audio + Sensory空间音频与感官系统
空间音频、气味、雾、风、水、震动、镜面与材料共同构成的感官系统。 Spatial audio, scent, mist, wind, water, vibration, mirrors and material-based sensory systems.
06
Technical Integration技术集成
技术选型、设备与供应商整合、结构协调、安装调试、现场交付与维护。 Technology specification, supplier coordination, structural integration, installation, commissioning, delivery and maintenance.
Studio / 工作室 / 04
VIRTURA connects spatial perception, moving image and creative technology.

我们以体验设计和空间媒体为核心，从概念、影像、交互与声音出发，组织技术供应链并完成真实空间中的整体交付。

VIRTURA 是在「轩空间感知（XUAN）」空间设计与项目实践框架下展开工作的跨学科艺术团队与创作共同体，并与 TZONE（上海图域）等相关团队在不同项目中共同推进空间内容与现场实践。

Shanghai
Available worldwide
Core Team核心成员

Art, spatial design and creative technology in one studio.艺术、空间设计与创意技术协同于同一工作室。

01

Ewan Qian钱誉文

联合发起人 / 主理人 Co-founder / Creative Lead

沉浸式空间体验研究者与媒体艺术家，实践横跨实时视觉系统、点云影像与音画结构。他持续将作品创作、空间预演与数字舞台系统组织为可复用的长期方法。毕业于河南工程学院数字媒体艺术专业，曾参与上海 UFO Terminal、深圳 BO LIVE、舟山 CAN Festival、上海 THE BOXX 与日本新宿 WPÜ 等场地及项目的现场视觉与空间媒体制作。

An immersive experience researcher and media artist working across realtime visual systems, point-cloud imagery and audiovisual structures. His practice brings artistic production, spatial previsualisation and digital stage systems into a sustained, reusable methodology. He studied Digital Media Art at Henan University of Engineering and has contributed to live visual and spatial media projects at UFO Terminal Shanghai, BO LIVE Shenzhen, CAN Festival Zhoushan, THE BOXX Shanghai and WPÜ Shinjuku, Japan.

02

Xuan Shen沈轩

联合发起人 / 艺术总监 Co-founder / Artistic Director

数字艺术家与策展人，长期从事空间设计、公共叙事与跨文化展览实践，关注如何在建筑、媒介与社会语境之间建立清晰的空间表达。毕业于中国美术学院视觉传达专业，后于法国里昂第三大学完成硕士学习。现任中国美术学院视觉传播学院客座导师、中国国家地理自然教育中心艺术顾问，并曾担任首届上海静安国际光影艺术节评委。曾获 2026 iF 设计奖，并获 MIA 2023 行业领军人物称号。

A digital artist and curator whose practice spans spatial design, public narrative and cross-cultural exhibition contexts. He develops spatial frameworks that connect architecture, media and social experience. He graduated in Visual Communication from China Academy of Art and later completed postgraduate study at Jean Moulin University Lyon 3. He is a guest tutor at the School of Visual Communication, China Academy of Art, an art advisor to the National Geographic China Nature Education Center, and served as a jury member for the inaugural Shanghai Jing’an International Light Art Festival. His recognitions include an iF Design Award in 2026 and the MIA 2023 Industry Leader title.

03

Murphy Nile周子凌

跨媒介艺术家 / 交互艺术设计师 Transmedia Artist / Interactive Art Designer

跨媒介艺术家与交互艺术设计师，主要从事互动体验、实时三维与视听系统的构建，关注技术如何重组感知关系，并由此发展新的互动语言与数字美学。硕士毕业于伦敦大学金史密斯学院。曾入围英国流明奖 Lumen Prize 沉浸式体验单元，作品曾于米兰 引擎电影节、卡尔斯鲁厄 IDIF电影节、柏林 SUPERBOOTH、凯迪拉克·上海音乐厅、上海西岸美术馆及重庆“流光绘影”光影科技艺术节等平台展映与呈现。

A transmedia artist and interactive art designer working with participatory experiences, realtime 3D and audiovisual systems. His practice examines how technology reorganises perception, using creative technology to develop new forms of interaction and digital aesthetics. He holds a master’s degree from Goldsmiths, University of London. His work was shortlisted for the Immersive Experiences category of the Lumen Prize and has been presented at Engine Film Festival Milan, IDIF Karlsruhe, SUPERBOOTH Berlin, Cadillac Shanghai Concert Hall, West Bund Museum Shanghai and the Luminous Imaging Art and Technology Festival in Chongqing.

04

Cui Fang崔放

三维动态设计 / 生成艺术 3D Motion Design / Generative Art

三维动态设计师与生成艺术创作者。她以具象对象为起点，通过数字重构、材质研究与抽象转译，建立带有个人印记的超现实空间与动态视觉语言。毕业于密歇根大学建筑专业。曾获上海国际光影节穹顶单元银奖、重庆“流光绘影”光影科技艺术节优秀作品奖，作品亦曾入选台北 Lumitree LED 光廊展映。

A 3D motion designer and generative artist whose work begins with recognisable objects and transforms them through digital reconstruction, material exploration and abstraction. She develops surreal spatial experiences and moving-image languages with a distinct personal signature. She studied Architecture at the University of Michigan. Her work received the Silver Award in the Dome category of the Shanghai International Light Art Festival and an Outstanding Work Award at the Luminous Imaging Art and Technology Festival in Chongqing, and has also been shown at Taipei’s Lumitree LED Corridor.
